resources.title: Everything You Need to Know About 0.4 in 18 Minutes
resources.creator: Zizaran
resources.noteEs: Zizaran condensa todo el patch 0.4 (Last of the Druids) de PoE 2 en 18 minutos: nueva ascendencia Druid, mecánica de liga Fate of the Vaal, ajustes de balance y endgame. Anchor de mechanics-per-league para los players que arrancan PoE 2 cada nueva temporada.
resources.noteEn: Zizaran condenses the entire PoE 2 0.4 patch (Last of the Druids) into 18 minutes: new Druid ascendancy, Fate of the Vaal league mechanic, balance adjustments, and endgame changes. Anchor for mechanics-per-league for players entering PoE 2 each new season.

resources.title: PoE 2 0.4 — The Most Important Tip for League Start
resources.creator: Lolcohol
resources.noteEs: Lolcohol enfoca un solo punto crítico para el league start de 0.4: cómo aprovechar la nueva mecánica desde el campaña sin desperdiciar runs. Más conciso que el overview de Zizaran, complementario para players que ya leyeron lo principal y quieren la jugada práctica del día 1.
resources.noteEn: Lolcohol focuses on a single critical point for the 0.4 league start: how to leverage the new mechanic from campaign onward without wasting runs. More concise than Zizaran's overview, complementary for players who've read the main coverage and want the practical day-1 play.

resources.title: The MOST Important New Juicing Mechanic — PoE 1 3.28 Mirage League
resources.creator: Path of Evening
resources.noteEs: Cobertura del lado PoE 1 (3.28 Mirage League / Keepers of the Flame). Path of Evening explica la nueva mecánica de juicing — cómo escalar drops y profit en el endgame con el sistema agregado en esta liga. Importante porque GGG sigue rotando ligas en PoE 1 mientras PoE 2 está en early access.
resources.noteEn: Coverage from the PoE 1 side (3.28 Mirage League / Keepers of the Flame). Path of Evening explains the new juicing mechanic — how to scale drops and profit in endgame with this league's added system. Important because GGG keeps rotating PoE 1 leagues while PoE 2 is in early access.

resources.title: Tenemos que hablar de Path of Exile Mirage — 3.28 League Review
resources.creator: KroximatuZ
resources.noteEs: KroximatuZ entrega el review más extenso en español de la liga Mirage de PoE 1: 28 minutos cubriendo la mecánica, balance changes, recepción de la comunidad, comparación con ligas previas y reflexiones sobre la dirección general del juego. Anchor obligatorio para players hispanohablantes que quieren profundizar en el state de PoE 1.
resources.noteEn: KroximatuZ delivers the most extensive Spanish review of PoE 1's Mirage league: 28 minutes covering the mechanic, balance changes, community reception, comparison with previous leagues, and reflections on the game's general direction. Mandatory anchor for Spanish-speaking players who want depth on PoE 1's state.

resources.title: TODO sobre la NUEVA LIGA THE LAST OF THE DRUIDS! 0.4.0
resources.creator: BuBahz
resources.noteEs: Versión española del overview de PoE 2 0.4: BuBahz cubre lo esencial de Last of the Druids en 9 minutos — qué es la mecánica nueva, qué cambia, dónde están los rewards. Compacto y al grano, ideal para players hispanohablantes que prefieren formato corto al video largo de Zizaran.
resources.noteEn: Spanish version of the PoE 2 0.4 overview: BuBahz covers the essentials of Last of the Druids in 9 minutes — what the new mechanic is, what's changed, where the rewards are. Compact and direct, ideal for Spanish-speaking players who prefer short format over Zizaran's longer video.
